## UML: Room

:::: {style="font-size: 1.8rem"}

```
+-----------------------------+
|      Room                   |
+-----------------------------+
| - name: str                 |
| - description: str          |
| - doors: List<Door>         |
| - items: List<Item>         |
+-----------------------------+
| + enter()                   |
| + show_items()              |
| + show_doors()              |
| + add_door(d:Door)          |
| + add_item(i:Item)          |
| + take_item(name:str): Item |
+-----------------------------+
```

#### Beziehung Room - Door

::: fragment

```
            1    * 
Room ------------------> Door
            contains
```

:::
::::


## UML Door

::::: {style="font-size: 1.8rem"}

```
+---------------------+
|      Door           |
+---------------------+
| - target_room: Room |
| - is_open: bool     |
+---------------------+
| + open()            |
| + close()           |
| + is_open(): bool   |
+---------------------+

        ^ 
        |
        | inheritance
        |

```

:::: columns
::: column

```
+--------------------+
|   NormalDoor       |
+--------------------+
|  (no extra fields) |
+--------------------+
```
:::

::: column

```
+---------------------------------+
|     KeyDoor                     |
+---------------------------------+
| - required_key: str             |
+---------------------------------+
| + try_open(player:Player): bool |
+---------------------------------+
```

:::
::::
:::::


## UML: Item

```
+--------------------+
|      Item          |
+--------------------+
| - name: str        |
| - description: str |
+--------------------+
| + describe()       |
+--------------------+
```


## UML: Player

```
+----------------------------+
|     Player                 |
+----------------------------+
| - current_room: Room       |
| - inventory: List<Item>    |
+----------------------------+
| + enter_current_room()     |
| + show_inventory()         |
| + has_item(name:str): bool |
| + take_item(name:str)      |
| + go_through(index:int)    |
+----------------------------+
```

Player --> Room (current_room)
Player --> Item (inventory)
Player --> Door (go_through)
